about: The maintainer's rulings on the open grouping questions, as the judge prompt carries them. 'proposed' means he has not ruled yet and the prompt carries the reading proposed to him; every split names its rule, so a ruling flips those calls without a rerun.
rule_2: Different people reacting to the same news are different claims: one claim per speaker's reaction (Gaethje hitting back at Topuria's post, or Tsarukyan ripping it, is each its own claim, not part of the post's claim). The fighter's own defence or reply stays with his original claim. Fans' or the crowd's reaction, reported as a group, is its own claim too. An article that reports several reactions belongs with its main one. (Ruled by the maintainer, 2026-11-05.)
rule_4: Each issue of a recurring column or ranking is its own occasion: a later weekly issue of the same power rankings is its own claim. (Proposed reading of #383; the maintainer has not ruled.)
